sourceSufficiencyAssessment: PASS is limited to the selected retained argument, not all seven books/parts or final-edition coverage. The supplied evidence is substantially more than blurbs: actual Chapter 1, an extended author manuscript discussion, specific author procedures and explicitly labelled supplementary draft/later explanations support the retained links. Omitting the unseen detailed medical/technical chapters, Fat Tony episodes and numerical examples does not materially reverse this stated argument. The real practices that remain—barbell separation, selection of trials, subtraction, reserves and the Seneca mental exercise—have primary locators and are not replaced with coaching. Nonlinearity is explained in ordinary language; the mathematical term convexity is not required to establish that account. No unsupported essential link identified.
substantiveParityAssessment: All 24 RU/EN titles, bodies, source notes, method notes and all three routes read. Qualifications about suitable loading, recovery, selection, asymmetric trials, intended-help harm and personal loss allocation survive both languages. Seneca is explicitly Taleb’s reading; later Lindy/green-lumber explanation and the suitcase draft retain honest labels. No material translation mismatch or new management/moral prescription found.
